items.front: State the mutual exclusion condition for deadlock.
items.back: A resource is held by one process at a time.

items.front: State the hold and wait condition for deadlock.
items.back: A process holds one resource while waiting for another.

items.front: State the no preemption condition for deadlock.
items.back: Resources cannot be taken away from a process holding them.

items.front: State the circular wait condition for deadlock.
items.back: A cycle of processes each waiting on the next.

items.front: How can deadlock be prevented by breaking circular wait?
items.back: Impose a global order on resources and acquire them in that order.
